description: Update an existing SyncPen document's title and/or content. Documents whose owner set them to suggest-only or excluded will refuse a direct write — use syncpen_suggest_edit there instead. The response reports how many other documents link to this one, so you can check they still make sense after your change.

documentId.description: The ID of the document to update

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the ISO 8601 updatedAt from your last read. If the document changed after it, the update is rejected as a conflict so you can re-read, merge, and retry — instead of silently overwriting someone else's edit.

name: syncpen_update
